specializationChoices: Explicit fixed policy: Focus for Firewall, Sustained control for Encryption at level 3; no human or adaptation claim.

policies.existing: Unmodified DeterministicPlayerPolicy: ensure Encryption; grow attackers to min(14,2+ceil(wave/2)); add one Distributor from wave 4; upgrade lowest-level attackers, ties by localeCompare ID.
policies.firewall-only: Existing policy, rejecting every non-Firewall purchase.
policies.expansion-heavy: Buy Firewalls until no affordable legal slot remains; never upgrade or buy other types.
policies.upgrade-heavy: Ensure one Encryption and one Firewall; upgrade lowest-level attackers until blocked; then buy at most one Firewall per preparation. No support.
policies.weak-placement: Existing policy with ascending coverage positions (ties x then y), including zero-coverage cells.
policies.counter-aware: Existing growth/support/upgrade order, but each Firewall request chooses the higher upcoming HP-weighted base effective DPS per Dharma of Firewall/Encryption; ties Firewall. Ensure Encryption as usual. No future knowledge beyond the incoming authored roster; ignores status/aura/projectile/targeting benefits in this heuristic.
